name: White Dune
hero_subtitle: A pure white sand dune rising from the lagoon — one of Dakhla’s most photographed views.

overview.title: White sand over turquoise water
overview.p1: The White Dune (Dune Blanche) is a bright sand mass rising at the lagoon’s edge — a short climb that rewards you with views over water, peninsula and desert.
overview.p2: Most visitors come for late light. The sand is soft; wear closed shoes and carry water. It is a scenery stop more than a long hike.
overview.p3: Combine with a lagoon shore drive or a kite-spot transfer if you are based at a camp.

q1.question: How far is the White Dune from Dakhla town?
q1.answer: It is a drive along the lagoon. Confirm current access and transfer time with your hotel or kite camp.

q2.question: Is the climb difficult?
q2.answer: Short but soft sand. Average fitness is enough; carry water and wear closed shoes.

q3.question: Best time for the White Dune?
q3.answer: Late afternoon into sunset for the strongest colours over the lagoon.

q4.question: Can I combine it with Dragon Island?
q4.answer: Yes. Both fit a shared lagoon outing with a driver or tour.

q5.question: Are there facilities at the dune?
q5.answer: Very limited. Bring water, sun protection and anything else you need.
